# National Education Policy Center

> NEPC is a research center providing evidence-based policy analysis, briefs, and reviews on critical education issues including school funding, choice, special education, and emerging technologies.

The National Education Policy Center (NEPC) at the University of Colorado Boulder conducts rigorous research and policy analysis to inform education decision-making. NEPC collaborates with leading education research organizations and experts to examine pressing policy questions across K-12 and higher education.

## Key Topics

- Education Policy Research
- Policy Briefs
- Policy Reviews
- School Funding
- School Choice
- Special Education
- Public Schools
- AI in Education
- Education Reform
- Evidence-Based Policy
- K-12 Education
- Policy Analysis
- Educational Equity
- Research Methods

## Research & Policy Analysis

- [National Education Policy Center](https://nepc.colorado.edu): NEPC homepage providing education policy research, briefs, and analysis on key education issues.
